verdict.rationale: A runtime probe of the public npm registry confirms @babylonjs/core is published under the Apache-2.0 open-source license, and its code is publicly distributed. The official llms.txt describes Babylon.js as an "open" game and rendering engine. Missing for 10: no evidence of a public source repository (e.g. GitHub) or first-party docs on browsing or building the source, and no explicit license documentation on the product's own site.
